productName: AeroDispatch Fleet Telemetry & Freight Routing System
targetAudience: Freight dispatchers and night-shift logistics coordinators managing 400+ simultaneous vehicles
operationalContext: Multi-monitor dispatch workstation, 12-hour shifts, continuous real-time telemetry streaming
dataVisualizationNeeds: Live GPS route tracking, multi-series vehicle battery/fuel telemetry, locked column dispatch triage grid

concepts.identityRationale: Utilitarian, crisp, high-density command center tailored for continuous dispatch triage. Emphasizes instant tabular scanability and status clarity over decorative whitespace.

layout.columnGrid: 12-column responsive grid with fixed 260px collapsible dispatch tree
layout.densityMode: Compact Operate (36px table row height, 8px base grid)
layout.focalPoint: Active vehicle status triage table and GPS anomaly alert bar

surface.elevationModel: Border-first with 1px structural borders (#E2E8F0) and dual micro-shadows (0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04))

primaryCharts: Line chart with anomaly detection highlights
dataVisualization.telemetryDensity: High (up to 1,000 telemetry points per minute)

accessibility.wcagLevel: WCAG 2.2 AAA text contrast (14.8:1 on card)
accessibility.ambientLightNotes: Optimized for glare-free daytime office lighting

uxTradeoffs.strengths: Maximum operational throughput; dispatchers can triage 40 vehicles per screen without scrolling
uxTradeoffs.risks: Requires onboarding for novice operators due to dense information grouping
uxTradeoffs.operationalFit: Highest fit for experienced coordinators handling high-volume dispatches

concepts.identityRationale: Dark slate high-contrast environment engineered specifically for night-shift operators. Minimizes pupil fatigue and draws sharp eye focus to urgent route bottlenecks via vibrant amber/emerald alerts.

layout.columnGrid: Asymmetrical 3-pane workbench (Fleet Map 50%, Telemetry Stream 30%, Alert Queue 20%)
layout.focalPoint: Real-time vehicle map tile and critical route deviation drawer

surface.elevationModel: Pure border-defined surfaces with zero ambient blur (1px solid #243042)

iconography.style: Technical vector outline with reinforced contrast
iconography.geometry: Monoline vectors with crisp optical alignment

primaryCharts: Multi-series line chart with alert threshold bands

accessibility.wcagLevel: WCAG 2.2 AAA text contrast (14.2:1 on dark card)
accessibility.ambientLightNotes: Engineered for 24/7 dark control room settings

uxTradeoffs.strengths: Zero eye fatigue during 8-hour night monitoring; critical alerts pop immediately
uxTradeoffs.risks: Reduced readability in brightly lit mobile field scenarios
uxTradeoffs.operationalFit: Ideal for centralized dispatch operations centers
